RulesElement.name: Golden Reckless Strike
RulesElement.specific: 1[W] + Strength modifier damage. Level 21: 2[W] + Strength modifier damage.
If you're wielding an axe, a hammer, or a mace, you gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to your Constitution modifier.

RulesElement.name: Golden Mind Lash
RulesElement.specific: 3d10 + your highest ability modifier psychic damage.
You or one ally within 5 squares can spend a healing surge and regain additional hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier.

RulesElement.name: Golden Twin Fang
RulesElement.specific: You must be wielding two melee weapons.
2[W] + 1[W] (off-hand weapon) + twice your Strength modifier + 4 fire damage.
2[W] (off-hand) + Strength modifier damage. Until the end of your next turn, you also gain combat advantage and concealment against the target.
If you're wielding two melee weapons, the attack deals extra damage equal to your Dexterity modifier.

RulesElement.name: Golden Hunter's Choice
RulesElement.specific: Strength vs. AC (melee) or Dexterity vs. AC (ranged)

1[W] + 1d8 + Strength modifier damage (melee) or 1[W] + 1d8 + Dexterity modifier damage (ranged). Increase damage to 2[W] + 1d8 + Strength modifier damage (melee) or 2[W] + 1d8 + Dexterity modifier damage (ranged) at 21st level.
The attack deals extra damage equal to your Strength modifier.

1d8 + Wisdom modifier radiant damage. Increase damage to 2d8 + Wisdom modifier at 11th level and 3d8 + Wisdom modifier at 21st level.

RulesElement.name: Golden Pack Strike
RulesElement.specific: 1d8 + beast's Wisdom modifier psychic damage, and the target is immobilized (save ends).
If your companion is a cat, a spider, or a wolf, the attack deals extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

RulesElement.specific: You summon a Medium ember spirit in an unoccupied square within range. The summoned creature has speed 6.

RulesElement.name: Golden Steed
RulesElement.specific:
Golden Steed - Large immortal beast (mount) - Initiative equal to yours, Perception equal to yours
HP your bloodied value
Healing Surges none, but you can spend a healing surge for the steed if an effect allows it to spend one
Defenses your defenses +1, not including any temporary bonuses or penalties
Resist 5 all
Speed 8, fly 8
Traits Steady Charge (mount) - The steed's rider gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls on charge attacks.
Standard Actions m Kick (At-Will) Attack: Melee 1 (one creature); your level + 5 vs. AC Hit: 2d6 + your Charisma modifier damage.
Triggered Actions C Glare (radiant, Encounter) Trigger: An enemy enters a square adjacent to the steed. Attack (Immediate Reaction): Close burst 1 (triggering enemy); your level + 3 vs. Will Hit: 1d8 + your Charisma modifier radiant damage.

RulesElement.name: Summon Golden Heron
RulesElement.specific: You summon a Medium golden heron in an unoccupied square within range. The heron has speed 6 and fly 8 (hover). It has a +4 bonus to AC and a +2 bonus to its other defenses. The heron has resist 5 fire. You can give the heron the following special commands.
Melee 1; targets one creature; Intelligence vs. Reflex; 1d8 + Intelligence modifier fire damage.
Melee 1; targets one creature; Intelligence vs. Reflex; 1d8 + Intelligence modifier fire damage.
If you haven't given the heron any commands by the end of your turn, it attacks the nearest enemy.
As above, and the heron has fly 10.
